name: Martial Glacier
why: From the edge of town to a small glacier in an hour and a half, with the Beagle Channel below you all the way.
book: Free. Taxi or walk up the road to the Cumbres del Martial teahouse.
water: Meltwater streams; the teahouse at the start.
dangers: Loose scree under the glacier: don't walk onto the ice.

points.name: Cumbres del Martial teahouse
points.note: At the top of the road, about 7 km above the town centre.

points.name: Lookout over Ushuaia and the Beagle Channel
points.note: Where the old chairlift ended: the whole bay and the Chilean islands across the channel.

points.name: Martial Glacier
points.note: About 1,000 m, at the foot of the glacier cirque.
